name: TheHive
description: TheHive is StrangeBee's security incident response platform for managing alerts, cases, tasks and observables, with Cortex analyzers and responders for enrichment and response

flow.description: Drive TheHive from a workflow: create and update alerts, cases, tasks and observables, and run Cortex analyzers and responders.
examples: Turn an external detection into a TheHive alert with its observables
Auto-promote an alert to a case and create the standard playbook tasks
Run Cortex analyzers on every new observable, then comment the verdict in the case
